en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a waterfront scene with a calm harbor in the foreground and several buildings on the quay. On the right is a long, low stone building with a gabled roof; behind it rises a more formal neoclassical-style building with many windows and a central entrance, and a small tower or lighthouse with a flag on top. Low hills appear in the background. There is a red Greek postage stamp with a postmark at the upper left, and Greek captions printed along the bottom, plus a modern website watermark.
